2.  **New focal or diffuse left or right ventricular function abnormalities**: The report notes "FE ai limiti inferiori" (EF at lower limits), which indicates a functional abnormality (decreased ejection fraction). In the context of myocarditis, this is considered a new or acute functional change.

The report explicitly states "normali dimensioni" (normal dimensions) and "spessori... 10 mm" (normal thicknesses), ruling out ventricular dilation and wall thickness changes. It states "non versamento pericardico" (no pericardial effusion), ruling out abnormal fluid collection. - Option 2 (New focal or diffuse left or right ventricular function abnormalities) is supported by "FE ai limiti inferiori" and the regional hypokinesia.

The prompt asks to select options based on what the evidence states. The evidence confirms both segmental wall motion issues and functional depression (low EF).
